blocks.lead: Channels for reporting complaints of corruption and misconduct by staff of the Office of the Royal Society

intro: If you witness staff of the Office of the Royal Society engaging in what may be corruption or misconduct, you can file a complaint through the following channels

sections.heading: Complaint box for corruption and misconduct
paragraphs: 1st floor, Office of the Royal Society

sections.heading: By mail
paragraphs: Anti-Corruption Operation Center (ACOC), Office of the Royal Society, The Government Complex Commemorating His Majesty the King's 80th Birthday Anniversary, 5th December B.E. 2550 (Building C), Chaeng Watthana Road, Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210
